seo.title: 3-Day Desert Tour from Marrakech to Merzouga | Erg Chebbi (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €295 pp. 3-day desert tour from Marrakech to Merzouga (private 4x4 or shared). Includes Erg Chebbi camel trek, Sahara luxury camp, Ait Ben Haddou & local guide.
seo.lead: This three-day trip connects Marrakech to the high orange dunes of Erg Chebbi in Merzouga. You travel in a private, air-conditioned vehicle across the High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi n'Tichka pass (2,260m), stopping at the earthen ksar of Ait Ben Haddou and Ouarzazate before spending the first night in the Dades Valley. On Day 2, the road passes through Tinghir to reach Todra Gorges before continuing to Merzouga for a sunset camel ride and desert camp overnight. Day 3 returns to Marrakech via Alnif, the Draa Valley, and the High Atlas.
seo.primaryKeyword: 3 day desert tour from Marrakech to Merzouga

price.label: From EUR 295 per person
price.note: Includes private A/C transport, licensed driver-guide, 1 night in a Dades Valley riad/hotel, 1 night in a desert camp, dinners, daily breakfasts starting Day 2, and camel rides. Luxury camp upgrades with private bathrooms are available on request.

seo.imageAlt: Camel caravan trekking across golden Erg Chebbi sand dunes at sunset on a 3-day Merzouga desert tour from Marrakech
highlights: Cross the High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi n'Tichka pass (2,260m)
Walk through the UNESCO-listed Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou and stop in Ouarzazate
Explore the 300-meter canyon walls of Todra Gorges
Ride camels across the Erg Chebbi dunes at sunset and sunrise
Spend a night in a Sahara camp with dinner, campfire music, and stargazing
Travel in a modern A/C 4x4 or minivan with a local licensed driver

faqs.question: Is this tour private or shared?
faqs.answer: Most guests book this as a private tour, which lets you stop whenever you like for photos, coffee, or rest breaks. We also run small-group shared departures on select dates.

faqs.question: How much driving is involved between Marrakech and Merzouga?
faqs.answer: The round trip is roughly 1,120 km. Splitting it over three days keeps the pace manageable: Day 1 covers about 310 km to Dades Valley, Day 2 covers 250 km to Merzouga, and Day 3 returns via the Draa Valley and Ouarzazate.

faqs.question: What are the desert camps like?
faqs.answer: Standard camps offer private tents with real beds and shared bathrooms. Luxury camps provide larger private tents with en-suite hot showers, flush toilets, and power outlets. Both include dinner, breakfast, and evening music around the fire.

faqs.question: Can we finish the tour in Fes instead of returning to Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes. Days 1 and 2 stay the same. On Day 3, instead of turning west toward Ouarzazate, your driver heads north through the Ziz Valley, Midelt, and the Azrou cedar forest, dropping you in Fes by early evening.

faqs.question: Do you accommodate vegetarian, vegan, or gluten-free diets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Riads and desert camps regularly prepare vegetable tagines, couscous, and fresh salads. Let us know your dietary needs when booking so we can inform the kitchens ahead of time.
